title.narrative: Environmental Program for Disaster Risk and Climate Change Management
Programa Ambiental de Gestin de Riesgos de Desastres y Cambio Climtico

description.narrative: El objetivo del Programa es reducir la vulnerabilidad de poblaciones rurales frente a fenmenos asociados al cambio climtico a travs de acciones de gestin de riesgos basada en el manejo y conservacin de recursos naturales en cuencas priorizadas por su vulnerabilidad.

The objetive of the Program is to reduce the vulnerability of rural communities to to events associated to climate change through risk management activities based in natural resources management in prioritized basins chosen by its vulnerability.
